name: Brimstone's Blood raises Demon's Blood's proc chance by 25 points (#1587)
contract: Brimstone's Blood 300387 reads 'Increases the chance of gaining a stack of Demon's Blood by 25%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; matches the client's own moa_description). The chance belongs to the innate class passive Demon's Blood (804345, ProcChance 25 in the installed Spell.dbc, granted at class tiers 6/7 in AscensionCustomClassData.h): 'Damage taken has a 25% chance to generate Rage and grant Demon's Blood.' aura_ascension_xoroth_event::Check (AscensionXorothEvents.cpp) rolls this manually via AscensionXoroth::Chance(player, 804345), bypassing the native spellmod pipeline entirely, so Brimstone's Blood's own baked SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS effect (even though its classmask does match 804345) is never read; it is nulled in ApplyContracts. The fix adds Amount(300387) = 25 as Chance()'s bonus parameter, so the roll becomes 50% while the talent is known. On each successful roll, Proc() (AscensionXorothEvents.cpp case 804345) casts 521226 (Rage) directly via the AscensionXoroth::Cast() helper - a script-issued cast with no aura named as its trigger, so spell_cast_count (not spell_proc_count, which requires native trigger-spell recording) is the metric that observes it, per the README's guidance for script-driven casts. The scenario counts 521226 casts over two equal-length mutual-combat windows against the same weak, high-health training dummy: 48 melee-swing-taken trials at the baseline 25% chance yield an expected 12 (std 3), so a null-hypothesis run producing 20 or more has under 1% probability (z ~ 2.7); the talented window (50% chance, expected 24) clears 20 with about 90% power (z ~ -1.3). The test only requires the talented window's count to exceed the untalented window's, and separately clears the loose absolute floor.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Give the knight enough of a health buffer to survive the whole combat window
Ensure the innate Demon's Blood passive is known
SETUP: Demon's Blood is known without Brimstone's Blood
Start mutual combat without the talent
Let ~48 damage-taken trials resolve at the baseline 25% chance
SETUP: combat actually generated Rage grants at the baseline chance
SETUP: Brimstone's Blood is now known
Resume mutual combat with the talent known
Let ~48 more damage-taken trials resolve at the boosted 50% chance
CONTRACT: the talented window generates markedly more Rage grants than the untalented window
